errors.text: The hypothesis substitutes high-temperature strength and creep resistance for resistance to thermally induced toughness or ductility loss.
It misses the specific AlCoCrFeNi2.1 FCC+B2 starting microstructure and the intermediate-temperature aging intervention.

It assigns L12 precipitates a beneficial strengthening role, whereas the target mechanism links enhanced L12 ordering, elevated APB energy, restricted cross-slip, and jagged phase boundaries to embrittlement near 600°C.
It predicts neither the ductile-brittle-ductile transition nor recovery near 750°C.
The proposed experiment does not measure toughness, ductility loss, crack initiation, phase-boundary morphology, ordering, or impurity segregation.
